 BELOIT, Wis. (WKOW) —  Two children died and an adult went to the hospital after a house fire broke out in the 1100 block of Hinsdale Avenue early Sunday. 
 Firefighters responded to the home around 3:47 a.m., finding it in advanced stage with heavy smoke. They made entry to search the home and attack the fire, locating the two children deceased inside. 
 The Rock County Medical Examiner's Office will assist in the death investigation. 
 The City of Beloit Fire Department, the City of Beloit Police Department and the State Fire Marshal are all investigating the cause of the fire, which remains active and ongoing.
